items.observations: Original watercolor and pencil botanical illustration showing the whole Cardamine hirsuta plant from a low basal rosette of rounded pinnate leaflets, a larger terminal leaflet and thin erect flowering stems, to small white four-petalled flowers and multiple upright long slender siliques. Inspected against a black background.
items.limitations: A stylized educational botanical illustration, not a photograph, authenticated herbarium specimen or definitive identification key. Fine hairs and fruit outlines are simplified.
